known_stalls_stops_assistance.description: This capture is a deliberate low-PWM/variable-PWM start-stop test at Grillers, a track grade documented elsewhere as stall-prone under load (docs/IR_SENSOR_NOTES.md:41, docs/ROAD_TO_CTO.md). The filename and 'start-stop' naming, plus the anchor bracket, establish that repeated starting/stopping was the INTENDED test -- not that any specific excursion in it is a confirmed stall.
known_stalls_stops_assistance.evidence: docs/IR_SENSOR_NOTES.md line 41 ('...caused a stall on the Grillers grade'); docs/ROAD_TO_CTO.md ('No stall on the Grillers grade under any load tested')

known_stalls_stops_assistance.description: A telemetry-only low-PWM dwell-window proxy (ctl_pwm_actual <= 5 for >= 1000ms, computed by tools/hwt_excursions.py) exists for this capture and is reported per-excursion as phys_in_low_pwm_dwell in the decision CSV. This is NOT a confirmed stall/assist boundary -- a commanded stop, a scheduled dwell, and a genuine stall are indistinguishable in PWM telemetry alone (see tools/hwt_excursions.py module docstring section 6).

uncertainty_notes: The anchor interval '066-067' does not by itself establish whether marker 66 or marker 67 is the starting position, nor whether QUORUM's own CW/CCW enum convention (MAP_CW=+1 increments mm, MAP_CCW=-1 decrements it) matches the physical rotational sense the operator means by 'CCW' in the anchor text. mm=66 is used here as a documented, unverified assumption.

The portion of the capture BEFORE t=1176.689714 (roughly the first 1176 seconds) is not covered by this anchor bracket at all and is excluded from this manifest's confirmed run -- events reported by the replay tool before the declared start time have no operator-confirmed reference and are diagnostic only.

No independent wheel-speed or odometer ground truth exists in this capture. The physical-timing gate's maximum-credible-speed bound is inherited from QUORUM's own explicitly-provisional PWM-to-velocity model (see tools/quorum_map.py), not independently validated here.
Marker-specific repeatability cannot be inferred from this single pass; only one capture is available per direction/speed combination for this investigation.
